errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: '1. First cube: red. 2. Second cube: yellow. ... 6. Sixth cube: green.' — implies only one roll observed.

errors.description: Model failed to sum green occurrences across all rolls, instead counting only one instance from a single roll.

analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the temporal structure of the task. Instead of tracking the top face of each cube across five sequential rolls (as described in the ground truth reasoning), it analyzed only a single frame or assumed a single roll occurred. This led to counting green only once, whereas the correct answer requires summing green appearances across all five rolls (which totaled 5 times). The error is primarily temporal (misinterpreting sequence) with downstream reasoning failure in counting.
